image_description: A close-up shot of a white bowl containing several dark purple figs and smaller orange kumquats. One fig in the foreground is cut in half, revealing its red/pink interior with seeds. Another whole fig sits next to it, showing a small stem and a slight tear in the skin. The background features blurred orange fruits and a warm orange backdrop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pear-shaped fruit with soft, thin skin in green, purple, or brownish coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The primary subjects are clearly pear-shaped with deep purple/brownish skin, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth to slightly wrinkled texture with matte finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin appears smooth with a natural matte-to-satin finish, consistent with real figs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated pear shape with tapered form from broad base to narrow stem end.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whole figs exhibit the correct tapering geometry from the bulbous body to the neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small ostiole (eye) at bottom of fruit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bottom (ostiole end) of the visible whole figs is either occluded by other fruits or facing away from the camera; only the stem ends are clearly visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Narrow stem end contrasting with broad rounded base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central whole fig clearly displays a narrow neck/stem area transitioning into a wider body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin, easily bruised skin covering soft interior.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a small tear on the side of the central fig, revealing the soft interior and suggesting thin, delicate skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals hollow interior filled with numerous tiny seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The halved fig on the right clearly shows a dense matrix of tiny seeds within the pulp.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Sweet, pink to amber-colored fleshy pulp surrounding seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The interior flesh is a vibrant pink/red color, consistent with ripe purple figs.
The visual appearance of the cut surface suggests a moist, soft, jam-like consistency rather than a dry or fibrous one.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific botanical identity of the fruit and distinguish it from similar fruits like plums or dates.
To assess overall image quality, lighting realism, and detect any subtle generative artifacts in textures or edges.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex seed-pulp interface in the cross-section, ensuring no melting or unnatural blending.
To ensure proper spatial relationships and depth of field between the foreground figs and background kumquats.

focus_areas: Internal structure of the cut fig (seed distribution and pulp texture)
Skin texture and reflectivity of the whole figs
Boundary sharpness between the fruit and the bowl/background
Consistency of lighting and shadows across multiple objects
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the internal structure of the cut fig. AI generators often struggle with the complex, repetitive pattern of seeds in figs, sometimes resulting in smearing, uniform noise, or structurally impossible seed arrangements. Verify if the seeds look distinct and naturally distributed. Also, check the tear in the skin of the central fig for realistic tissue exposure.
